resources.string: The assistant only collects information for the health staff. It does not give diagnoses or treatments. Questions are in Spanish.
On this phone the assistant runs on our server: your answers will be sent to generate the questions. They are not stored and do not include your name or ID document.
Download the assistant to this phone (Wi-Fi only)
The download will start when Wi-Fi is available. You can follow it in My details.
They will be sent to the health staff as your unverified answers. You can correct them before sending.
The assistant is not available. You can send your pre-registration with what you already answered.
Go to the emergency room now or call 123
What you describe may be a warning sign. Do not wait: go to the emergency room now or call 123. We are already sending your pre-registration.
It could not be sent. Retrying in %1$d s…
Your pre-registration was sent. Tell the staff when you arrive.
Your pre-registration could not be sent.
Optional download (about 2.6 GB, Wi-Fi only) so the questions are generated on your phone without sending your answers.
This phone does not have enough memory for the local assistant: questions will be generated on our server, with prior notice.
Ready: the assistant runs on this phone.
Not enough space: free up %1$d MB and try again.
The download failed verification and was deleted. Try again.
